title: Battlepack section 12 — License Nodes

container.notes: Section 12 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 file offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill; see container-battlepack). The section is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8 = 24, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by entryCount packed 24-byte entries and zero padding to a multiple of 16 bytes (see container-st2e).

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of license nodes (at most 368; vanilla 368).

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 24 (0x18) for this section.

fields.name: unknown0A
fields.notes: Not interpreted; keep.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output for this section).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: licenseNode
records.where: st2e entries of section 12: header.entryListOffset + i*24; row i = license node id i (row labels: list BpLicenseList); license board cells store these ids

fields.name: description
fields.notes: Help text id (license help block 17000+). The Lua Loader docs swap name and description (name at 0x00); see gaps.

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Name text id (license name block 6144-6505).

fields.name: lpCost
fields.notes: License points needed to obtain the node.

fields.name: type
fields.notes: Node type, which also sets the icon colour on the board (Workshop: "Type And Icon Color").

fields.name: restriction
fields.notes: Special rule (unique, quickening, summon, inaccessible).

fields.name: unlockedByDefaultFor
fields.notes: Characters that own this license from the start (one bit per original party member).

fields.name: content1
fields.notes: Granted content slot 1; meaning depends on type (equipment, action, augment …).

fields.notes: Granted content slot 2; meaning depends on type (equipment, action, augment …).

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
Keep exactly eight content slots per row and at most 368 rows.
unlockedByDefaultFor: change only bits 0-6; preserve bit 7.
Do not reorder rows: board cells and save data use the row id.
gaps: Name/description order conflicts between the Workshop (description first, used here) and the Lua Loader docs (name first).
Exact id space of content slots per node type, and the empty-slot sentinel (assumed 0xFFFF).
Bit 7 of unlockedByDefaultFor is not named.
Why the limit is 368 (presumably a fixed-size per-character license bitfield in the game).
